title: run_command dir fails with double-quoted path on Windows cmd.exe
description: During run 18eadcc3-b142-4096-b3ac-5cbde9dc570c (Phase 2 scope), calling run_command with `dir "src\moeb\internal" /b` returned an error on Windows cmd.exe. Removing the double quotes (`dir src\moeb\internal /b`) succeeded. The run.skill.md Shell Syntax section documents which cmd.exe built-in commands to use but does not note that the dir command does not accept double-quoted single-segment path arguments.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to the run.skill.md Shell Syntax section stating that cmd.exe dir (and similar built-in commands) do not accept double-quoted paths and must be passed unquoted when the path contains no spaces.
